body.message:
Hello,

I’m reaching out to check whether the property is still available for the indicated period (September 2026 to April 2027), and whether everything is confirmed on your end for these dates.

Additionally, I will be in Dubai from the 7th to the 13th and would like to take the opportunity to visit several properties, including yours if it is available.

Finally, if everything is confirmed, I am ready to proceed with the booking and payment quickly, as I need this accommodation for September 2026.

Looking forward to your reply.

Best regards,
